item.title: Ustad Rahat Fateh Ali Khan
item.description:
Legendary singer Rahat Fateh Ali Khan has announced a major one-off headline performance at The O2, London, on 18 April 2027.

As one of the most celebrated and influential voices in South Asian music, Rahat Fateh Ali Khan has established himself as a global icon through his extraordinary vocal ability, deeply emotional performances and mastery of Qawwali, Bollywood and traditional South Asian music. The highly anticipated London performance will bring Rahat's remarkable musical journey to one of the UK's most prestigious arenas for one special night. Audiences can expect an unforgettable evening featuring his greatest hits, beloved classics, powerful Qawwalis and songs that have captivated millions of listeners around the world.

Adding another special dimension to the evening, Rahat Fateh Ali Khan will be joined on stage by his son, Shahzaman Ali Khan, creating a unique father-and-son musical experience. The performance will showcase the continuation of a remarkable musical legacy, bringing together generations of the renowned Fateh Ali Khan family.

A particularly special element of the performance will be a tribute to Rahat's legendary uncle, Ustad Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan - one of the most influential Qawwali singers of all time. Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan's extraordinary voice and pioneering approach transformed Qawwali, taking the traditional devotional art form to audiences around the world. As a member of the renowned Fateh Ali Khan musical lineage, Rahat has carried that rich musical heritage forward, continuing to introduce the power and beauty of Qawwali to new generations. The O2 performance will celebrate both this extraordinary family legacy and Rahat's own hugely successful career, bringing together the traditional spirit of Qawwali with the songs and performances that have made him one of the most recognisable voices in South Asian music. With Shahzaman Ali Khan joining his father on stage, the concert will also offer audiences a glimpse into the next generation of the family's musical tradition, making this a particularly significant night for fans of Qawwali and South Asian music.

item.title: Teddy Swims
item.description:
GRAMMY®-nominated international superstar, Teddy Swims, has just announced his biggest EU/UK headline tour ever, including a stop at The O2, London on 21, 22, 24 and 25 April 2027. 

The tour announcement follows recent powerhouse singles ‘Mr. Know It All’ and ‘Break Up In Reverse’, and lands in the midst of a mammoth run of UK & EU festivals and outdoor shows that’s seen Teddy play Isle Of Wight Festival, Mad Cool, Rock Werchter, Lollapalooza Berlin and more, with a headline performance at Latitude still to come tomorrow night (Saturday 25th July).

Teddy only recently wrapped a Stateside summer run that culminated in triumphant returns to both BottleRock and Bonnaroo. He was also the only artist to play both Stagecoach and Coachella this year, and made headlines for bringing David Lee Roth, Joe Jonas, and Vanessa Carlton on-stage at the latter.

item.title: Thomas Rhett
item.description:
Fresh from a hugely successful US run of The Soundtrack To Life Tour, Diamond-certified country superstar Thomas Rhett has announced his long-awaited return to the UK with three arena shows in Manchester, London and Glasgow in April 2027. Thomas Rhett will be joined on these shows by special guest Kameron Marlowe. The tour marks Thomas Rhett's first UK headline run since 2018.

 

Thomas Rhett's latest album, ABOUT A WOMAN (Deluxe), expands what Country Living called his "best work yet" into a 25-track collection. The album features collaborations with Lanie Gardner, Blake Shelton, Teddy Swims and Tucker Wetmore, alongside his latest No. 1 hit, "Ain't A Bad Life" featuring Jordan Davis.

Over the past decade, Thomas Rhett has established himself as one of country music's defining artists. He has amassed 25 No. 1 singles, more than 16 billion global streams and eight ACM Awards, including 2020 Entertainer of the Year. His accolades also include two CMA Awards, five GRAMMY Award nominations, honours from the CMT Music Awards, Billboard Music Awards and iHeartRadio Music Awards, plus five CMA Triple Play Awards recognising his songwriting success.

item.title: Atlantic Starr
item.description:
Atlantic Starr, the celebrated American R&B and soul group behind hits including Secret Lovers, Always, Circles, Silver Shadow and One Lover at a Time, will bring their 50th Anniversary Greatest Hits Tour to indigo at The O2 in April 2027.

The special performance marks the band's only UK appearance and their first London show in over 20 years.

item.title: Thirty Seconds to Mars
item.description:
Thirty Seconds to Mars return to The O2 for a headline show on Wednesday 28 April 2027.

Thirty Seconds to Mars have announced their “A Beautiful Lie vs This Is War” tour, a powerful new live experience that brings together two of the band’s most iconic albums for one unforgettable night. For the first time, fans will experience two albums in one night, as the band performs the defining hits from both A Beautiful Lie and This Is War.

In a major moment for longtime listeners, former band member Tomo Miličević will rejoin Jared Leto and Shannon Leto, marking a rare and highly anticipated reunion on stage. Each night will deliver a high-impact, nostalgic performance that bridges past and present. Audiences will be transported back to the moments, memories, and emotions tied to these songs, while a new generation experiences their impact for the first time.

Released in 2005, A Beautiful Lie marked a breakthrough for the band, delivering global anthems like “The Kill” and “From Yesterday.” The album achieved multi-platinum status worldwide, propelled by its cinematic sound, emotional intensity, and genre-defining presence in the 2000s alternative rock landscape. Followed by 2009’s This Is War, the band expanded their sonic scope and global reach even further. The album produced an unprecedented run of hits including “Kings and Queens,” “This Is War,” and “Closer to the Edge,” earning multi-platinum certifications worldwide and reinforcing the band’s global success.

Two decades on, both albums continue to resonate with the same urgency and emotional weight that first connected with listeners, reaffirming their enduring legacy and cultural impact. The 17-date run will take the band across Europe and the UK, beginning April 6, 2027 in Lisbon and hitting major cities including Paris, Milan, Berlin, and London, before concluding May 1, 2027 in Dublin.

item.title: Gracie Abrams
item.description:
GRAMMY®-nominated singer-songwriter, Gracie Abrams returns to The O2 with her arena tour The Look at My Life in April and May 2027.

 

Since making her debut in 2019, Gracie Abrams has emerged as one of the most compelling singer-songwriters of her generation. Penning her first song at age eight, she went on to amass a devoted following with EPs minor (2020) and This Is What It Feels Like (2021), before embarking on a sold-out North American tour in 2022. Her debut album, Good Riddance (2023), sparked another headline tour that sold out in under one hour and earned Abrams the highly-coveted nomination for Best New Artist at the 66th Annual GRAMMY® Awards. Abrams then toured with Taylor Swift as the opening act on select dates of the blockbuster Eras Tour.

 

In 2024, Abrams released her sophomore album The Secret of Us, which became her first #1 album in the UK, Australia, and the Netherlands, and debuted at #2 on the Billboard 200. Its breakout single “Close To You” marked her first solo Billboard Hot 100 debut, while “us.” featuring Taylor Swift earned Abrams her second GRAMMY® nod, this time for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance. Its deluxe track “That’s So True” reached #1 on the US Spotify chart, entered Spotify’s Billions Club with over 1.5 billion streams, and became her first Billboard Hot 100 Top 10 hit. Abrams spent 2024 on The Secret of Us world tour, and 2025 on The Secret of Us Deluxe Tour, her first solo North American arena run.

 

Earlier this month, Gracie ushered in a new era with her single “Hit the Wall". Along with the single release, Abrams also shared the official video directed by Renell Medrano. “Hit the Wall” was Gracie’s highest Spotify streaming debut to date and is the lead single from her forthcoming third studio album, Daughter from Hell. Written and produced by Gracie alongside Aaron Dessner, Daughter from Hell will arrive on 17 July.

item.title: Simple Minds With Special Guest Gary Numan
item.description: Simple Minds will perform at The O2 on 6 May 2027 as part of their V Tour 2027, bringing their panoramic live music experience and celebrating five decades of music with fans.

item.title: CHANGE
item.description:
Disco-soul group Change is bringing The Very Best of Change to indigo at The O2 on Saturday 8 May 2027.

Formed in Bologna, Italy in 1980, Change quickly found success with their Chic-inspired grooves and soulful pop-R&B-oriented sound as their debut album The Glow of Love, which featured vocals from Luther Vandross and Jocelyn Brown, soared to the Top 10 on the Billboard Disco Charts. The title track from their first album was later sampled by Janet Jackson on her 2001 hit single ‘All for You.’

Now fronted by Rick Brennan, who joined the project in 1983, Change will perform their greatest hits, including ‘Change of Heart’, ‘A Lover’s Holiday’, ‘The Glow of Love’ and ‘Hold Tight’, for Southend and London audiences.

With their blend of velvety vocals and smooth harmonies, Change will transport concert-goers back to the golden era of soul and rhythm.

item.title: Maisie Peters
item.description:
The O2, the world’s most popular live entertainment, leisure and retail destination, owned and operated by AEG, has begun the countdown to its 20th birthday, marking two decades since opening with a programme of live shows that will include multi-night residencies, one-off special performances and exclusive shows.

Launching in May 2027 and running throughout the summer, the 20th anniversary shows will open a new chapter in the venue’s history, bringing together an exciting and diverse line-up of artists spanning rising stars to global icons across a range of genres.

The first artist to be announced is British singer-songwriter, Maisie Peters, who will perform her debut headline show at The O2 on Saturday 8 May 2027. With her highly anticipated new album Florescence, due to be released 22 May, Maisie represents the next generation of talent to take to The O2 stage, ushering in a new era of headliners and reflecting the venue’s ongoing commitment in presenting artists from grassroots to the global stage.

“Being the first artist announced for The O2’s 20th birthday celebration is honestly such an honour. I’ve been a fan of the venue for as long as I can remember and have watched so many shows there, so getting to step onto that stage for my own headline show feels like a real dream come true. The O2 holds so many iconic moments, and to be part of the very start of its next chapter makes this moment even more special and I can’t wait to share it with my fans.” said Maisie Peters.

“Celebrating 20 years of The O2 is a significant milestone for us,” said Steve Sayer, Senior Vice President and General Manager of The O2. “Over the past two decades, we’ve hosted more than 3,000 shows, welcomed over 100million visitors, and established The O2 as the world’s leading live entertainment venue with countless iconic live moments to its name.

“Our birthday celebrations are about reflecting on our success and legacy whilst continuing to look firmly to the future. Bringing together iconic acts alongside the next generation of talent is central to that vision. Maisie Peters represents a new era of headline artists, and we’re honoured that she’ll perform her biggest ever headline show at The O2 as part of our 20th birthday celebrations. We have an incredible line-up planned with activity taking place throughout the site, and we look forward to welcoming fans from across the country and beyond to celebrate with us.”

2027 will mark more than two decades of partnership between the venue and headline sponsor O2, who have worked together in close collaboration since the venue’s inception. The relationship – one of the UK’s longest-standing and most-recognisable naming rights partnerships - continues to go from strength to strength, connecting even more fans to the live experiences they love. Over the past two decades, O2 has sold more than four million Priority Tickets to shows at The O2 to its customers via Priority, the platform which offers fans access to tickets 48 hours before general sale and a host of perks from drinks discounts to queue jumps.

Gareth Griffiths, Director, Partnerships and Sponsorship, Virgin Media O2 commented: “We couldn't be prouder of our partnership with AEG and everything we have achieved together at The O2 in London – countless memories made at shows which have shaped music and entertainment as we know it, putting the fan at the centre of the experience every step of the way. Now, we look towards the future and artists like Maisie Peters who are at the top of their game and will truly define live music for the next twenty years; the perfect first artist to celebrate this milestone with us next year.”

item.title: Songs We Love – Folabi Nuel Live
item.description: Experience an unforgettable night of live music with award-winning artist Folabi Nuel as he celebrates a decade of music, memories, and milestones. Join us for an inspiring evening filled with powerful performances, soulful sounds, and a celebration of 10 incredible years of artistry.

item.title: Rod Stewart
item.description:
Sir Rod Stewart, one of the best-selling artists in the history of recorded music and one of the most successful touring artists of the last half century, is coming to The O2 with The Final Encore, marketing the culmination of an extraordinary live career spanning more than six decades.

Rod Stewart said, “My dear friends, The time has come to say farewell to life on the road. After more than six decades, The Final Encore will most definitely be my last. I’ve been singing the music I love since I was 19 years old, and I’ve had the privilege of taking it around the world to all of you. It has given me a life beyond anything I could ever have imagined, and I hope I’ve given you some fond memories in return. So, may I take this opportunity to thank you for making this extraordinary life possible. I hope you’ll join me so I can thank you the best way I know how… with the music and one hell of a show. See you there.”

item.title: ERASURE
item.description:
Erasure, the BRIT and Ivor Novello winning duo, have, since their formation in 1985, released a staggering number of albums and singles, in the process leaving an indelible impact on our musical landscape.

From their debut Wonderland (1986) to their twentieth album, Radio!! Radio!!, the enduring pop duo have released an unbroken run of acclaimed albums, selling over 25 million worldwide, and their live performances remain legendary.

From the triumphant but lovelorn ‘Sometimes’, which catapulted the band into the UK charts in 1986, to ‘A Little Respect’, ‘Blue Savannah’, ‘Always’, ‘Who Needs Love Like That’, ‘Chains of Love’ and ‘Hey Now (Think I Got a Feeling)’, the band’s seemingly endless stash of singles are the purest pop: life affirming, warmly familiar yet futuristic.

Erasure launch their 20th album release, Radio!! Radio!!, with a new track, ‘Wings Of Love’, alongside details of an arena tour in April/May 2027 across the UK and Europe.

Vince Clarke will be Musical Director for the tour but will not be appearing onstage alongside Andy Bell. He explains, “I recently moved to California from New York, and I travelled from here to London. The travelling took a toll - it really messed me up. I never seemed to recover from it. I just thought ‘I don’t want to do this anymore’. I told Andy, and he made me musical director, and I thought, ‘how fantastic is that?’ I can do all my work and all my direction from here, but I don’t have to leave sunny San Diego.”

Bell goes on to say, "I'm so pleased that we were able to find a way for the tour to work for Vince. He's always too modest but he's so much more than the Musical Director, Vince is one of the great loves of my life and everything we do as Erasure we decide together.”

item.title: Tame Impala
item.description:
Following sold-out runs across the globe in 2025 and 2026, and currently in the midst of a North American arena tour, Tame Impala has announced a new run of European dates for 2027, including a 3-night stand at The O2 in London on June 1, 2 and 3.

Wet Leg will open all headlining dates. 

The announcement arrives as Tame Impala continues an extraordinary run with his latest album Deadbeat.  Featured in Spiderman: Brand New Day, the LP’s “Loser” just hit #1 on the Global Spotify chart and is sitting in the top 25 on Billboard's Hot 100, while “Dracula (Jennie Remix)” remains in the top 10 on the chart after peaking at #5.  “Dracula” has also been nominated for Best Alternative at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards.

Tame Impala released his fifth full-length album, Deadbeat via Columbia Records in October 2025. On it, Parker sculpted a collection of wickedly potent club-psych explorations as a vehicle for some of his most direct, brain-wormy songwriting to date. The album includes 2 breakout hits with “Loser” as well as breakout single “Dracula” which reached #1 at Alternative radio before being reimagined with global superstar JEANNIE which brought together two singular pop worlds, with JEANNIE adding her vocals to the “Dracula (JENNIE remix).”

Deadbeat also scored Parker a GRAMMY award for Best Dance/Electronic Recording for the single “End Of Summer,” the only track eligible for the 2026 GRAMMYS.  He also picked up a BRIT Award nomination for International Group of the Year. Tame Impala has had 5 career GRAMMY nominations and now two wins, and has racked up three BRIT Award nominations and a win throughout his career.

item.title: Shreya Ghoshal
item.description:
The O2, the world’s most popular live entertainment, leisure and retail destination, owned and operated by AEG, has announced Shreya Ghoshal, one of India’s most beloved voices, as the next artist to join the 20th birthday series. Her show, confirmed for Friday 4 June 2027, is set to be deeply rooted in Indian tradition while resonating with a contemporary global sound.

Shreya Ghoshal joins The O2’s line-up of exclusive shows alongside previously announced British artist, Maisie Peters, who will perform on Saturday 8 May 2027. Running throughout summer 2027, the 20th birthday series will bring together an exciting and diverse line-up of artists spanning rising stars to global icons across a range of genres.

“When we were planning The Unstoppable Tour, I knew I wanted to begin the journey at The O2. It's one of the world's most iconic live music venues, with an incredible legacy of hosting some of the biggest artists over the past two decades. To now return to the same stage as part of The O2's landmark 20th anniversary celebrations feels like a wonderful full-circle moment. It's also quite rare to revisit the same venue within the same tour, which makes this performance even more special. I'm looking forward to sharing another unforgettable evening of music with audiences in London”, said Shreya Ghoshal.

“Our goal has always been to deliver a world-class and diverse programme to mark The O2’s 20th birthday, so we are really pleased to confirm Shreya Ghoshal as the second artist to join the line-up. As one of the most celebrated voices in Indian music, she brings extraordinary talent and global appeal to our birthday series as we mark two decades as the world’s most popular live music venue”, added Emma Bownes, Senior Vice President, Venue Programming at AEG International.

For over two decades, Shreya Ghoshal has remained an enduring force in Indian music, her voice a bridge across languages, genres, and generations. With this show, in celebration of the venue’s birthday, she looks both inward and forward, offering audiences a sweeping experience that blends nostalgia with reinvention. The show will journey through her most iconic hits while also unveiling new sonic chapters that reflect her evolving artistry.

Since opening in 2007, The O2 has hosted more than 3,000 shows, welcomed over 100million visitors, and established The O2 as the world’s leading live entertainment venue with countless iconic live moments to its name. 2027 will mark more than two decades of partnership between the venue and headline sponsor O2, who have worked together in close collaboration since the venue’s inception.

item.title: David Guetta
item.description:
Electronic music icon David Guetta is the latest artist to join The O2's 20th birthday celebrations, taking place throughout summer 2027. David Guetta’s show will take place on Saturday 5 June 2027. 

One of the most successful and influential artists of his generation, David Guetta will bring his world-renowned The Monolith Tour show to The O2 as part of the venue's landmark anniversary programme, joining a growing line-up of artists celebrating two decades of live entertainment at the iconic venue.

About David Guetta

DJ. Producer. Artist. David Guetta is a musical trailblazer, an international icon and the most cherished electronic artist of our generation. He has over 80 million monthly listeners, 50 billion streams, 40 million albums sold worldwide, 15 Grammy nominations and 2 Grammy Awards plus 110m followers across his social channels. He has won the accolade for best electronic artist at the MTV Europe Music Awards six times, four LOS40 Music Awards, the ‘Dance Act of the Year’ at iHeartRadio Music Awards again in 2026, ‘DJ of the Year’ at the NRJ Music Awards, #1 producer by 1001Tracklists and ‘Producer of the Year’ at the BRITs. 2025 also saw Guetta win his 3rd iHeartRadio Music Award for Dance Artist of the Year and this year was once again voted the world’s best DJ in the DJ Mag ‘Top 100’ for the fifth time.

Guetta is the #1 streamed DJ on Spotify and steadily in the Top 10, with a peak at #4 of the most listened to artists in the world on the platform. Guetta has collaborated with the world's biggest stars including Sia, Rihanna, Justin Bieber, Ariana Grande, Bruno Mars, Black Eyed Peas, Shakira, Nicki Minaj, OneRepublic, Teddy Swims, Kid Cudi, J Balvin, Raye, among many others. Such work has resulted in numerous hit singles both in the dance/electronic space as well as in the pop world, with 12 tracks achieving over 1 billion streams including “Hey Mama” (3.5 billion), the hotly anticipated follow-up to Spotify global #1 and streaming monster, “I’m Good (Blue)” (4.2 billion) that hit #1 at the US Top 40 & US Dance Radio charts and “Titanium” (3.3 billion), “Memories” and “Sexy Bitch” with 2 billion. Seven of Guetta’s singles have also reached the #1 spot on the UK singles chart. Guetta’s smash-hit ‘Beautiful People’ saw him team back up with Sia, achieving over 200 million streams. His latest hit, ‘Gone Gone Gone’ with Teddy Swims, Tones And I, has reached over 200 million streams, explores a stylistic shift in production from David - showcasing his long-standing ability to take risks and innovate.

A master creative across genres, Guetta has also gone from strength to strength with his underground-focused Future Rave project alongside Morten, and he is additionally working on new music for his underground alias Jack Back, and has released numerous releases alongside the wonder-kid DJ/producer Hypaton.

His global domination of the live stage shows no sign of slowing down. Guetta returned to his highly anticipated return to Ibiza for two summer residencies. Fans can catch his signature high-production performances at the island’s newest and largest venue, UNVRS, as well as at Ushuaïa Ibiza, home to his world-famous F*** Me, I'm Famous! Party.

Beyond Ibiza, Guetta’s Monolith tour continues across the globe this summer, hitting key festivals and stadiums worldwide. Highlights include a landmark three-night run at the iconic Stade de France in June 2026, selling over 240,000 tickets and reaffirming his status as one of electronic music’s most influential live performers. David Guetta has also performed at the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival in April 2026, appearing on the new Quasar stage.

As he continues to dominate the global charts and play some of the most exciting sets of his career, all while expanding his creative vision, exploring new sounds and evolving as an artist, David Guetta demonstrates time and time again why he is the most cherished electronic artist of our generation.

item.title: Billie Jean King & John McEnroe
item.description:
Billie Jean King & John McEnroe: Champions in Sport. Champions in Life. 

On Sunday 27 June 2027, the day before The Championships, Wimbledon begins, two of the sport’s greatest champions take The O2 stage for a unique and exciting spoken event quite unlike any other.  

Billie Jean King, the sports icon and equality champion who captured a record 20 Wimbledon championships, and John McEnroe, the man with the most combined singles and doubles titles in the Open Era and the voice of tennis, they didn’t just win - they changed the sport. They’ll share unfiltered stories from the biggest moments of their lives, both on and off the court, from McEnroe’s unforgettable back-to-back Wimbledon finals to King’s iconic “Battle of the Sexes” win over Bobby Riggs.  

At a time when success is often measured only by winning, Billie Jean and John offer a unique perspective. They’ll explore what it means to overcome adversity, handle pressure, learn from failure, break barriers, and keep moving forward when the odds are against you.  

This is a rare opportunity to hear from two Hall of Fame sporting legends, with 56 Grand Slam titles between them. They’ll reflect on the lessons they’ve learned from a lifetime spent competing at the highest level.

_____________________________________________________

The O2, the world's most popular live entertainment, leisure and retail destination, owned and operated by AEG, has announced that tennis legends Billie Jean King and John McEnroe will make their UK arena debut together in the only spoken word event as part of the venue's 20th birthday celebrations.  

Taking place on Sunday 27 June 2027, one day before the start of Wimbledon, the special ‘Billie Jean King & John McEnroe: Champions in Sport. Champions in Life.’ will see two of the sport’s most influential and iconic figures come together on stage for an evening of stories, insight and discussion, reflecting on their remarkable careers, the evolution of professional tennis and the moments that shaped the game. 

Celebrating The O2 at twenty throughout summer 2027, the birthday series will bring together an exciting and diverse line-up of artists, performers and special events, spanning rising stars to global icons across music, sport and entertainment. 

Confirmed 20th birthday events include: 

  • Maisie Peters - Saturday 8 May 2027 

  • Shreya Ghoshal - Friday 4 June 2027 

  • SOMBR - Tuesday 22 June 2027 

  • Billie Jean King and John McEnroe - Sunday 27 June 2027 

  • Don Omar - Monday 5 July 2027 

  • Jorja Smith - Saturday 17 July 2027 

With many more to be announced. 

Speaking on the spoken word event, Billie Jean King said: “Anytime John and I get together, it is a lively and engaging conversation, and I am looking forward to being part of The O2’s twentieth anniversary season. Tennis has given both John and me a wonderful platform for our lives and it will be fun to share stories that take the audience behind the curtain into the real world of our careers.”  

John McEnroe added: “I am really looking forward to coming to London for a first time ever show with Billie Jean King.  She is not only the most influential person in the history of Women’s Sports, but also my good friend and a living legend. Working together, we will give our very best to enlighten and entertain you at The O2 London on 27/6/27. We hope that you will join us for a great afternoon of live entertainment.” 

Emma Bownes, Senior Vice President, Venue Programming, AEG International, commented: "As we continue celebrating The O2's 20th birthday, we're delighted to welcome Billie Jean King and John McEnroe for what promises to be a truly fascinating evening. Both have had an extraordinary impact on sport and culture, inspiring generations through their achievements, and we look forward to welcoming fans to what will be a very special event.” 

The news comes ahead of the return of the Laver Cup to The O2 later this month. Having previously hosted the tournament in 2022, The O2 will become one of the few venues globally to welcome the event for a second time, underlining its enduring relationship with some of the biggest moments in international tennis. 

Since opening in 2007, The O2 has hosted more than 3,000 shows and welcomed over 100 million visitors, establishing itself as the world's leading live entertainment venue with countless iconic live moments to its name. 2027 will also mark more than two decades of partnership between the venue and headline sponsor O2, who have worked together in close collaboration since the venue's inception.

item.title: Don Omar
item.description:
Don Omar, global music icon and reggaeton pioneer, as the next artist to join the 20th birthday series. His show, confirmed for Monday 5 July 2027, will bring together his greatest hits for an unforgettable live music experience.

“It’s an honour to return to London, especially this time to celebrate with all of you. It’s going to be a very special celebration, and I’m incredibly excited”, said Don Omar.

Emma Bownes, Senior Vice President, Venue Programming at AEG International, added “As with all the artists we have announced for the birthday shows, Don Omar’s performance will be a 2027 UK indoor exclusive show, and we know he’ll bring incredible energy to the venue. Reggaeton music is known for its high-energy dance music and that’s exactly the type of party we want for this milestone birthday.”

item.title: Jorja Smith
item.description:
Singer-songwriter and two-time BRIT award winner, Jorja Smith, is the next artist to join the 20th birthday line-up. Jorja Smith’s show will take place on Saturday 17 July 2027.

Celebrating The O2 at twenty throughout summer 2027, the birthday series will bring together an exciting and diverse line-up of artists, spanning rising stars to global icons, across a range of genres.

Confirmed 20th birthday artists:

  • Maisie Peters - Saturday 8 May 2027
  • Shreya Ghoshal - Friday 4 June 2027
  • Don Omar - Monday 5 July 2027
  • Jorja Smith – Saturday 17 July 2027

With many more to be announced.

Jorja Smith said: “Performing at The O2 as part of its 20th birthday celebrations is a huge honour. It’s a venue that has hosted so many incredible artists and unforgettable moments over the years, so to be part of this milestone feels really special. I’m excited to celebrate with you all.”

Christian D’Acuna, Vice President, Programming at The O2, commented “We are so pleased to welcome Jorja Smith, for what will be her only UK arena performance of 2027, to our ever-growing 20th birthday line-up. The show will be Jorja’s first-ever headline performance at the venue, making it a special moment both for us at The O2 and for her fans.”

Renowned for her soulful voice and poignant lyricism, Jorja has made significant waves in the music industry since her debut "Blue Lights”. She has collaborated with artists including Stormzy, Kendrick Lamar, Burna Boy and more recently with Childish Gambino.

Since opening in 2007, The O2 has hosted more than 3,000 shows and welcomed over 100million visitors, establishing itself as the world’s leading live entertainment venue with countless iconic live moments to its name. 2027 will also mark more than two decades of partnership between the venue and headline sponsor O2, who have worked together in close collaboration since the venue’s inception.

item.title: The Dualers
item.description:
The Dualers return to indigo at The O2 with their Summer Never Ends Tour in December 2027. With special guest: DJ Ska N Mash

The Dualers are an 8-piece Jamaican Rhythm & Blues band from South-East London. They first hit the headlines when the single ‘Kiss on the Lips’ entered in to the UK charts at number  21 despite no industry or professional backing, the follow up single Truly Madly featured in full on the Hollywood blockbuster Fools Gold, the success has continued with several top 30 UK albums and large scale tours, which have included prestigious venues plus a record breaking 15 sold out shows at indigo at The O2. 

With an ever-increasing large worldwide fan base behind them and now being heralded as Britain’s finest Ska & Reggae band, The Dualers continue to play to sell-out crowds all over the UK, Europe & Asia.

In 2027, The Dualers hit the road once again for their ‘Summer Never Ends’ 2027 tour, featuring a mix of new material, fan favourites and timeless Dualers classics.
